game_concept: A quiz RPG set in The Kingdom – Archery Yard, the garrison archery yard: the knight must handle shadow scouts while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Constant Guardian: Tell fixed CONSTANTS from changeable variables; only change variables to unlock the wall banner.
theme: The Kingdom – Archery Yard: the garrison archery yard
core_gameplay_loop: In Archery Yard, repeat each round: Tell fixed CONSTANTS from changeable variables; only change variables to unlock the wall banner. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the energy value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 8 consecutive correct decisions about energy to power up the knight and open the wall banner.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 6 (applied tier): Constant Guardian
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Constant Guardian' (Week 1 slot 7), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Archery Yard'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how energy changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against shadow scouts in Archery Yard.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 8.
